在线推理恰好相反。请求量随业务流量波动，响应延迟比批处理吞吐更重要。按峰值负载预留加速卡，会在低谷留下大量空闲资源。缩容可以减少浪费，但流量回来后，新副本必须重新加载模型权重才能服务请求。如果启动缓慢或不可预测，平台团队就必须保留额外副本，推高单位 Token 成本。

Online reference is the opposite. Requests fluctuate with business flows, and response delays are more important than batch-processing in case of stow-off. Accelerators are set at peak loads, leaving a large amount of idle resources in the valley. Indentations can reduce waste, but when traffic returns, new copies must reload model weights to service requests. If start-up is slow or unpredictable, the platform team must keep additional copies and push up unit Token costs.

Kubernetes 在 1.34 中正式 GA 了 DRA（Dynamic Resource Allocation，动态资源分配）。DRA 的核心改进是让调度器参与资源分配，在 Pod 调度阶段就精确匹配设备属性，避免了 DevicePlugin“调度到节点后才发现资源不够”的问题。

Kubernetes officially GA in 1.34 has the DRA (Dynamic Resources Management, Dynamic Resource Allocation). The central improvement of the DRA is to involve Scheduler in resource allocation and to match equipment attributes precisely at the Pod Scheduling stage, avoiding the problem of DevicePlugin “scheduling not discovering insufficient resources until it reaches the node”.

如果按照正常逻辑实现 Filter、Score 等方法，最终 Scheduler 会汇总多个插件的打分，然后根据最终结果选择一个节点，**但是 HAMi 这边是要完全控制调度结果的，因此直接将 Filter、Score 逻辑融合到一起，最终就只返回一个目标节点，**这样最后肯定会调度到该节点。

If the Filter, Score and so on were to be achieved according to normal logic, Scheduler would eventually sum up the scores of multiple plugins and then select a node based on the final result,** but Hami was intending to have complete control over the results of Scheduling, thus directly integrating Filter, Score and finally returning only to one target node,** which is certain to reach that node.

底层由 Kubernetes 承担容器编排、节点、网络和存储等基础工作。向上一层，Volcano 处理批量任务调度，Kueue 管理作业队列与配额，HAMi 提供异构设备共享与管理能力。它们共同面对资源问题，但关注的粒度不同：队列决定任务获得资源的规则，设备管理还要处理一张卡如何供多个任务使用。

At the bottom, Kubernetes handles container orchestration, nodes, networking, and storage. 两层树形结构将配额组与叶子业务配额分开。配额组按 GPU 类型或业务关键程度划分，通过标签绑定节点，不同组之间不互相借用资源。同一组内，叶子配额可以借用超过保障值 Min 的空闲容量；发生竞争时，由 Max 决定各自获得的份额。若配额 A 的 Max 是 B 的两倍，A 获得的可借用容量大致也是 B 的两倍。

The two-storey tree structure separates the quota group from the leaf business quota. Quota groups are divided by GPU type or level of operational criticality, and the different groups do not borrow resources between themselves by labeling a node. In the same group, the leaf quota can be borrowed in excess of Min's spare capacity; when competition takes place, Max decides on his share. If quota A is twice as much as B, A receives roughly twice as much loanable capacity as B.

从原理上看，算力虚拟化的工程价值并不来自某个拦截点或插件本身，而来自对“设备语义与资源承诺”的端到端维持：同一份算力与显存配额，必须在不同驱动、运行时与并发负载下始终成立。这使得行业中常见“开源可见部分”与“工程可依赖能力”之间天然存在断层，后者往往依赖调度、治理与运行时协同形成的系统闭环，难以通过零散代码直接验证。

The rationale is that the engineering value of a company resource is not derived from an interception point or plugin per se, but rather from end-to-end maintenance of “equipment syntax and resource commitments”: the same data base and GPU memory quotas must be maintained under different drivers, running together with loads. This leads to natural faults between the commonly available “open visible parts” in industry and “engineerable capacity”, which often rely on scheduling, governance and operating systems that work in concert, and are difficult to verify directly through discrete codes.

在 CUDA 程序架构中，host 代码部分在 CPU 上执行，是普通的 C 代码。当遇到数据并行处理的部分，CUDA 会将程序编译成 GPU 能执行的程序，并传送到 GPU，这个程序在 CUDA 里称做核 (kernel)。device 代码部分在 GPU 上执行，此代码部分在 kernel 上编写 (.cu 文件)。

In the CUDA program structure, the host code part is executed on the CPU and is a normal C code. When encountered with the data in parallel processing, CUDA compiles the program into a program that GPU can execute and transmits to GPU, which is called kernel in the CUDA. The device code part is performed on the GPU and this code part is written on Kernel (.cu file).

The KAI Scheduler adaptation shows the division of labor between HAMi-core and the scheduling ecosystem. 原生 ResourceQuota 独立计算每项资源，无法理解其内在关联。例如，当一个 Pod 请求 2 个 GPU，每个分配 2000MB 显存时（nvidia.com/gpu: 2，nvidia.com/gpumem: 2000），原生 Quota 会错误地将总显存需求记为 2000MB，而不是正确的 2 * 2000MB = 4000MB。这导致配额管理严重失真。

Original ResourcesQuota calculates each resource independently and does not understand its intrinsic relevance. For example, when a Pod requests two GPUs each allocated to 2000 MB GPU memory (nvidia.com/gpu: 2, nvidia.com/gpumem: 2000), the original Quota mistakenly recorded total GPU demand as 2000MB instead of the correct 2 *2000MB = 4000MB. AWS 自主设计 Inferentia / Trainium 芯片，是为了在其云服务中构建更加高效、成本可控的 AI 加速基础设施。Inferentia 偏向于 推理加速，Trainium 偏向于 训练加速。这些芯片专为 AI 工作负载设计，其设计目标不仅在算力提升，同时在功耗控制和成本效率上发力。Inferentia2 在性能／瓦特比（perf per watt）上做了显著优化，Trainium2 宣称比同类 GPU 实例节省 30–40%。HAMi 这次也是突破性的完成了和 AWS 芯片的集成、包含调度、虚拟化、可观测性。

The AWS Autonomous Design Inferentia / Trainium chip is designed to build more efficient and manageable AI acceleration infrastructure in its cloud service. Inferentia favours accelerated access, Trainium prefers faster training. These chips are designed for AI work loads, not only to upgrade their targets, but also to work on power consumption control and cost efficiency. Inferentia2 has made a significant optimization of performance/wattyby, which claims to have saved 30-40% from similar GPU examples.

在与密瓜智能的沟通中提到，在上一代以 CPU 为核心的云计算时代，诞生了像 VMware 这样的虚拟化巨头。如今到了以 GPU 为核心的 AI 智算时代，AI 任务负载对算力的需求与底层硬件分配方式之间也同样存在巨大的错配，虚拟化是通向 AI 普惠的核心钥匙。国产算力多元异构百家争鸣的现状，也赋予 HAMi 开源更深远的意义，开源不再只是情怀，而是生存发展的必需，是对当前算力秩序的重塑。HAMi 想要打破硬件的藩篱，让算力成为像水一样随手可得的公共基础设施，帮助多元异构芯片与全球生态共振。在这一趋势中，HAMi 有望成为异构算力调度虚拟化的全球通用标准。

In its communication with Dynamia, it was mentioned that during the last generation of cloud computing centred on CPUs, a giant like VMware was born with virtualization. Now in the age of AI, with GPU at its core, there is also a huge mismatch between the demands for computer resources and the distribution of bottom hardware.

在具体实现层面，分享重点解析了 Ascend Device Plugin 在设备初始化、筛选与分配阶段的工作机制，通过在 device-share 中注册昇腾资源，实现 Volcano 对昇腾设备的统一调度与按需分配。同时，针对 device-plugin 仅注册卡数、缺乏显存等关键资源信息的问题，社区引入了 Mock Device Plugin 方案，通过解析节点 annotation 自动补齐资源维度，并将显存等信息标准化注册到 Kubernetes 资源模型中。该能力显著提升了资源可观测性与调度精度，为异构设备在多调度器环境下的统一管理与精细化使用提供了可落地的工程实践。

At the practical level, the sharing of information has focused on analysing the working mechanisms for the initialization, screening and distribution phase of the equipment, achieving harmonization between the Volcano and the needs-based distribution of Ascend equipment by registering ascend resources in device-share. At the same time, with regard to the number of cards registered only for the data-plugin, lacking key resource information such as GPU memory, communities have introduced the Mark Device Plugin programme, which provides an enabling engineering practice for the uniform management and fine use of the facility in a multischeduler environment through the analysis node annotation autocompensation of resource dimensions, and standardized registration of information such as GPU memory into the Kubernetes resource model.

llm-d 是由 Red Hat 发起，构建在 vLLM、SGLang 等推理引擎与 Kubernetes 之上的云原生分布式推理框架，目前已交由 CNCF（Cloud Native Computing Foundation，Linux 旗下的云原生计算基金会）托管。项目聚焦大模型服务化落地中的前缀缓存感知路由、负载感知调度与 Prefill/Decode 分离等关键能力，将单服务器节点的推理引擎转换为多节点协同的"生产级分布式推理系统"。诞生至今，llm-d 已获得超过 4400 个 GitHub Star，英伟达 GPU、谷歌 TPU、AMD GPU、英特尔 XPU 等主流算力平台均已在该社区中形成各自的部署指南。

llm-d is a cloud-native distributed inference framework initiated by Red Hat, built on top of inference engines such as vLLM and SGLang and on Kubernetes, and now hosted by the CNCF (Cloud Native Computing Foundation). The project focuses on the capabilities that matter for production LLM serving — prefix-cache-aware routing, load-aware scheduling, and Prefill/Decode disaggregation — turning single-node inference engines into multi-node, coordinated, production-grade distributed inference systems. Since its inception, llm-d has earned more than 4,400 GitHub stars, and major compute platforms including NVIDIA GPUs, Google TPUs, AMD GPUs, and Intel XPUs have each established deployment guides in the community.

卓驭科技的驾驶云在 Kubernetes 上运行自动驾驶数据流水线，并为算法和数据工程师提供配备 GPU 的开发环境，内部称为 Codespaces。使用默认调度器时，多租户突发提交、GPU/CPU 资源碎片，以及无法让所有 Pod 同时启动的分布式作业，限制了资源分配率和利用率。团队引入 Koordinator 的 ElasticQuota、Reservation、Device Share 和 Gang Scheduling 扩展调度器，并将 Device Share 与 HAMi 结合，实现运行时 GPU 隔离。引入这些能力后，平台管理着 100 多个 ElasticQuota，每天调度 30 万至 80 万个 Pod。GPU 分配率超过 95%，整体利用率超过 55%，Codespaces 所需整卡数量减少约 60%。

When using default Scheduler, multi-tenant flash submissions, GPU/CPU resource fragments, and the inability to allow all Pod simultaneously to start distributed operations limit resource allocation and utilization. The team introduced Elastic Quta, Reservation, Device Share, and Gang Scheduling Extension Schemer, which combines Device Share with Hami to reduce the total number of cards needed by about 60 per cent.

HAMi 核心 maintainer 李孟轩在演讲中介绍了 HAMi 从 2.7.0 到 2.8.0 的能力演进：一方面，在"可用性"上，2.7.0 新增调度原因可视化与资源配额监控优化，用户不仅能一眼看出 Pod 为什么 Pending，还能更准确统计显存配额使用，解决虚拟化带来的 quota 失真问题；另一方面，在"生态与硬件"上，HAMi 已支持 9 家厂商 GPU，并扩展到昆仑芯 XPU、AWS Trainium / Inferentia 等异构设备，通过 Web UI 将这些能力以更友好的方式呈现。面向未来，2.8.0 版本重点优化调度性能与 Web UI 的异构设备支持，并规划通过 DRA 将原有 scheduler 与 device plugin 能力收敛到新的 DRA driver 中，在不改变用户使用习惯的前提下，提供更标准化的动态切分、硬隔离与多维资源指定能力，为后续大规模集群落地打下基础。

In a presentation by HAMi Core Manager Mengxuan Li described the evolution of HAMi's capabilities from 2.7.0 to 2.8.0: on the one hand, on "availability", 2.7.0 new Scheduling reasons such as visualization and optimization of resource quota monitoring, users not only see why Pod Pending but also more accurately measure the use of the GPU quota in order to address quta distortions arising from virtualization; on the other hand, on the "ecological and hardware" HAMi has supported nine manufacturers with GPU and extended it to the original SCHEPU, AWS Trainium/Inferentia, which provides a much more standardized base for future use through Web UI, and where it is planned that the existing scheduler capacity will be transferred to the new RADriver facility, making it available to the user more standardized, changing the base for future.

在实际业务场景中，虚拟化不是"是否使用"的问题，而是"用哪一种副作用最小"的选择题。来自蔚来的云端工程部训练加速负责人李鹏围绕"基于 HAMi vGPU 的训练性能优化框架"展开分享，重点介绍了在虚拟化环境下实现高精度性能诊断的完整路径。李鹏指出，HAMi 基于 perf 的虚拟化机制为性能分析提供了天然入口：通过拦截 CUDA/cuBLAS/NVML 等 GPU 核心库，无需改动业务代码即可捕获 GPU 全链路函数调用。这种无侵入式数据采集使得未来团队能够全面记录显卡执行逻辑、kernel 调度、显存使用与通信行为，并补充以外部 perf 采样构建 CPU/GPU 双侧时间线。通过时间轴融合，可精确还原任务在任意时间点的执行状态，识别低并行度、通信阻塞或异常 API 参数等关键瓶颈。在产品化层面，该框架实现了"底层瓶颈定位 + 上层代码溯源"的闭环诊断：既能量化算力与显存利用效率，也能跨进程关联具体业务模块。该体系已成功应用于蔚来自动驾驶训练场景，为大模型推理链路优化、多模态任务提速提供参考，显著减少了 GPU 资源浪费。

In the actual business landscape, virtualization is not a question of "use or non-use" but an option of "the least by-effects". The cloud engineering department from NIO trains the accelerated head Li Pen to share around "the training optimization framework based on HAMi vGPU", highlighting the complete path for achieving high accuracy diagnostics in the context of virtualization. Lepton noted that HAMi-based virtualization provides a natural entry for performance analysis: via intercepting CUDA/cubLAS/NVML core libraries, such as CPU timelines, which can be used to reduce time-to-time between GPU and GPU full-chain functions. This uninvasive data acquisition enables future teams to fully document the logic of narcology, kernel Skilling, GPU memory uses and communications behavior, and complements the external PPU/GPU time line, which can also be used to reduce the time-to-to-time interface between GPU and the ALTXC-LQL.

来自「DaoCloud」道客的产品负责人卢传佳分享了 d.run 智算调度平台在 SaaS GPU 租赁场景 × HAMi 虚拟化能力上的深度实践。d.run 以云原生方式将各类 GPU 资源池化输出给用户，支持训练、推理、数据处理等形态；在算力云业务中，HAMi 作为底层虚拟化核心，为平台提供国产 GPU 统一接入、显存与算力的灵活切片能力。卢老师指出，企业自建场景普遍受限于"整卡"使用方式，利用率难以突破；而 SaaS 租赁模式虽然可依靠即时付费提升资源弹性，却极易受到供需波动影响，使 GPU 池出现"既碎片化又不稳定"的运营风险。HAMi 的动态切片与超配能力在此发挥关键价值——不仅显著降低碎片化，让单卡可输出更多 SKU（如 3G / 6G / 12G / 24G 等），还通过显存动态扩容避免因 OOM 触发容器重启，提升资源稳定性与库存精细化管理。目前，d.run 已基于 HAMi 构建 GPU 切片租赁平台，实现多集群池化管理、国产卡统一调度、租户级优先级与抢占策略，并在推理 MaaS、企业大模型部署与 C 端 GPU 云使用等多场景落地。卢老师表示，随着 HAMi DRA、Quota 改进等新能力成熟，算力云将进一步实现资源复用最大化，让 GPU 资产的商业价值被"切得更细、用得更满"。

来自星环科技的人工智能产品部 AI - 工具平台研发侯雨希围绕 LLMOps 平台在寒武纪、海光等国产加速器上的适配实践展开分享，重点介绍了如何借助 HAMi 统一管理多型号、多架构的国产 GPU，并结合 DRA 构建可扩展的算力抽象。侯老师介绍，星环 LLMOps 平台承担企业级大模型全生命周期管理任务，需同时满足多租户隔离、资源组管理、任务排队策略、自定义显存/算力切片模板与全链路可观测性。为此，HAMi 成为连接不同 AI 加速器的关键底座。在寒武纪适配中，团队解决了 sMLU 动态切片的粒度限制、多型号资源名隔离，以及硬编码显存单元导致的总量无法计算等问题，并通过节点 label、型号识别与资源对象数组配置，实现与昇腾/英伟达一致的多型号管理能力。在海光 DCU 场景中，团队进一步解决设备 ID 不唯一、exporter 无法正确暴露指标、Pod–设备映射错误等问题，通过驱动 SDK 获取硬件序列号、重建设备唯一 ID，并重写 exporter 逻辑以匹配哈密设备插件的记录方式，确保指标与调度一致性。面向未来，侯老师指出 DRA 将成为异构 GPU 的统一抽象方向，通过 DRA 新增的 API，以及可消耗的容量和可切分设备的特性，使算力切分完成从自定义到 Kubernetes 原生的升级。星环科技也将继续与 HAMi 社区合作，推动国产 AI 算力的统一调度与更标准化的算力建模体系。

专注 GPU 虚拟化与异构算力管理，通过 GPU 共享、隔离和调度，让企业现有算力得到更高效的使用。基于 HAMi 开源技术，为已有 AI 平台提供可集成的资源管理能力，也为企业提供统一的 GPU 管理平台。

We specialize in GPU virtualization and heterogeneous compute management. Through GPU sharing, isolation and scheduling, we help enterprises make more efficient use of their existing compute resources. Built on HAMi open-source technology, we offer resource management capabilities that integrate with existing AI platforms, as well as a unified GPU management platform for enterprises.

about.first: Dynamia was founded by the creators and core maintainers of HAMi, a CNCF Incubating project, with a mission to build the open-source core of AI infrastructure. Through open-source collaboration, we develop the underlying scheduling and virtualization capabilities for heterogeneous compute, making GPUs and other AI accelerators easier to use, more efficient and easier to govern in cloud-native environments. Focused on heterogeneous GPU resource virtualization, efficient scheduling and production deployment, Dynamia helps enterprises turn fragmented, complex and costly compute resources into infrastructure that can be shared, isolated and consumed on demand.
about.second: HAMi is currently the only open-source project in the industry dedicated to heterogeneous GPU resource virtualization and efficient scheduling. It improves resource utilization through flexible, reliable, on-demand and elastic GPU virtualization, with lightweight, pluggable and non-intrusive deployment across public, private and hybrid clouds. HAMi supports mainstream GPU and accelerator providers including NVIDIA, AMD and AWS, and integrates seamlessly with upstream and downstream open-source schedulers such as Volcano, Koordinator, Kueue and KAI Scheduler, steadily building a reliable heterogeneous compute ecosystem. The community now brings together more than 500 contributors from over 60 countries, with growing participation and adoption by more than 300 enterprises.
